text: dsh-notify-sound-plus 是面向 DSH 网页与桌面客户端的会话提醒插件：在任务完成、需要回答、需要授权或运行出错时识别会话事件，并按模式播放提示音。它通过客户端设置行和输入框静音按钮接入 DSH，提供逐事件音效选择、音量与前台策略设置、系统通知、临时静音以及自定义音频上传。适合希望在切换窗口或处理多个会话时及时收到提醒的 DSH 用户。无需 API 密钥；系统通知需授予客户端通知权限，自定义音频保存在本机 DSH 数据目录。

dsh-notify-sound-plus alerts DSH users when tasks finish, need an answer or approval, or fail. It adds event sounds, volume controls, optional system notifications, and a composer mute button. Users can choose built-in tones or upload audio. No API key is needed; sounds are stored locally.

dsh-notify-sound-plus 的功能「会话事件提示」：识别任务完成、等待回答、等待授权和运行出错事件，并按当前模式播放对应声音。
dsh-notify-sound-plus 的功能「声音与通知设置」：在通用设置中控制提醒模式，并为各类事件选择音效、调节音量和前台提醒策略；可开启系统通知。
dsh-notify-sound-plus 的功能「自定义音频」：用户可在设置面板上传受支持格式的音频作为提示音，也能查看和删除已上传音效。
dsh-notify-sound-plus 的功能「临时静音」：点击对话输入框左下角的喇叭按钮即可切换提示音静音状态，系统通知仍由独立开关控制。
dsh-notify-sound-plus 会把设置及上传音频写入本机 DSH_HOME 指定的数据目录；未设置时使用 ~/.dsh。

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · dsh-notify-sound-plus：一款类官方风格的系统通知提示插件，它能给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套**提醒**。  
在任务完成 / 需要回答 / 需要授权 / 运行出错时 设置通知与提示音，并可通过**系统通知**在后台提醒。适配网页端与桌面端。

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 插件能做什么：- **系统通知**：需要回答 / 授权 / 任务完成时发送系统通知，可在设置里自行设置
- **在设置里直接选**：哪个事件要提醒、用哪个声音，都能单独调，选完自动试听。
- **换成你自己的声音**：可以上传 mp3 / wav 等音频文件当提示音。
- **智能判断**：如果开启了小鲸鱼挂件提醒将不提示（未开启事件由本插件提醒），避免重复提醒。
- **一键静音**：对话框小喇叭，点一下即可快速静音。
- 默认不吵你：子任务不提醒，自行终止不提醒，刷新页面也不提醒。

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 插件设置：**通用设置** —— 点开模式下拉即可切换提醒模式（开启 / 关闭 / 智能判断）：

它在「通用设置」里的位置，就在「字号大小」下方：

**详细设置窗口** —— 逐事件开关与选音、音量、前台策略、系统通知、自定义音频：

**对话左下角的静音喇叭** —— 只静声音，不影响系统通知：

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 四种提醒：四种默认音刻意在**音区、音色、节奏**上错开，任意一个维度都能分辨，不需要靠"听音高"：

| 什么时候 | 默认声音 | 听感特征 |
| ---- | ---- | ---- |
| 任务完成 | 高音区单响铃（正弦）+ 泛音 | 一击即止，余韵最长，干净发亮 |
| 需要回答 | 中高音区两音上行（三角波） | 尾音往上抬，像一句问话 |
| 需要授权 | 中音区同一个音连敲三下（方波） | 靠节奏辨认，像"喂、喂、喂" |
| 运行出错 | 偏低音区下行长音（锯齿波） | 唯一带粗糙感的负向音色 |

除四种默认音外，另有 8 种内置音色可换，按音区与节奏区分：

- **下行类**：叮咚（下行双音）
- **长音类**：铃音（长余韵）、低鸣（单声长音）
- **短促类**：水滴（极短高音）、叩门（低音两下）、警示（方波三连）
- **上行类**：轻柔（弱起双音）、上扬（四音上行）

每个事件都能单独指定其中任意一种，也可以上传自己的音频。

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 2. 通用设置里的那一行：打开「设置 → 通用」，会看到「声音提醒」：

- **模式下拉框**：
  - `开启提醒` —— 所有事件均提醒
  - `关闭提醒` —— 所有事件均不提醒
  - `智能判断` —— 与小鲸鱼挂件协助提醒（未开启事件由本插件提醒）
- **播放图标**：试听。
- **齿轮图标**：打开完整设置窗口。

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 3. 完整设置窗口（点齿轮）：界面与 DSH 官方设置窗口一致。里面分成三组：

- **提醒**：四个事件各配一个开关 + 声音下拉 + 试听按钮；  
  音量滑杆；「前台运行时不提醒」（仅在后台运行时提醒）。
- **系统通知**：一个总开关（打开时会申请系统通知权限）。  
  打开后，**需要回答 / 授权 / 任务完成**时发送系统通知；运行出错不发送，避免噪音。  
  系统通知与声音是**两条独立通道**——临时静音只静声音，不影响系统通知。
- **自定义音频**：上传自己的音频（mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a，单个 ≤ 2MB）。

窗口底部附有 GitHub 仓库地址。

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 4. 临时静音：对话输入框左下角的小喇叭：

- 点一下 → 已关闭提示音
- 再点一下 → 已开启提示音

这里的「提示音」只指**声音**：静音不会关闭系统通知。

这个开关**重启就恢复**，不用担心忘了打开。

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 常见问题：**1.没有声音提示？**

检查浏览器或桌面端是否已开启声音，设置里模式是不是 `关闭提醒`，或者喇叭是不是静音了。

**2.担心和其他插件提醒重复？**

把模式设为「智能判断」即可。

**3.声音能换成自己的吗？**

可以。设置里「上传音频」选文件，支持 mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a，单个 2MB 以内。

**4.在使用中遇到问题怎么办？**

如在使用中遇到问题，欢迎积极反馈！请访问GitHub仓库 https://github.com/SciF-Lin/dsh-notify-sound-plus 提交Issues，我们将尽快修复。

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · dsh-notify-sound-plus：An official-style notification plugin that adds a set of **alerts** to DeepSeek Harness.
Configure a sound and an optional system notification for each of four events — task completed / needs your answer / needs your approval / run failed — and get notified even while you are in another window. Works in both the web GUI and the desktop app.

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · What it does：* **System notifications** — sent when the model needs your answer, needs your approval, or completes the task; configurable in settings.
* **Pick it right in Settings** — choose per event whether to alert and which sound to use, with instant preview.
* **Use your own audio** — upload an mp3 / wav file as the alert sound.
* **Smart mode** — if the whale widget is already alerting for an event, this plugin stays quiet (events the widget does not cover are still handled here), so you never get a double alert.
* **One-click mute** — a speaker button next to the composer silences everything instantly.
* **Quiet by default** — sub-agent turns, your own aborts, and page reloads never replay old alerts.

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · Settings：**General settings** — open the mode dropdown to switch alert modes (on / off / smart):

Its position inside General settings, right below **「字号大小」** (font size):

**Detailed settings dialog** — per-event switches and sound pickers, volume, foreground policy, system notification, custom audio:

**Mute button at the bottom-left of the composer** — silences sound only, not system notifications:

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · The four alerts：The four defaults differ across **register, timbre and rhythm** — any one of those is enough to tell them apart, so you never have to compare pitches by ear:

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · The four alerts：|Event|Default sound|What it sounds like|
|-|-|-|
|Task completed|High single strike (sine) with overtones|One hit, longest ring, bright and clean|
|Needs your answer|Two notes rising, mid-high (triangle)|Tail lifts upward, like a question|
|Needs your approval|One mid note struck three times (square)|Identified by rhythm — knock, knock, knock|
|Run failed|Low descending sustain (sawtooth)|The only rough-edged, negative-sounding tone|

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · The four alerts：Eight more built-in tones are available per event, grouped by register and rhythm:

- **Descending**: chime (two falling notes)
- **Sustained**: bell (long ring), hum (single low tone)
- **Short**: drop (very brief high blip), knock (two low knocks), alert (three square pulses)
- **Ascending**: soft (quiet two-note rise), rise (four notes going up)

Any event can be pointed at any of them, or at an audio file you upload.

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 2. The row in General settings：Open **Settings → General** and you will see **「声音提醒」**:

> The plugin UI is currently in Chinese only. The labels below are shown as they appear on screen, with the English meaning in brackets.

* **Mode dropdown**:

* `开启提醒` (alerts on) — every event alerts
  * `关闭提醒` (alerts off) — no event alerts
  * `智能判断` (smart) — coordinates with the whale widget (events it does not cover are still alerted here)
* **Play icon**: preview the sound.
* **Gear icon**: open the full settings dialog.

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 3. Full settings dialog (click the gear)：* **「提醒」 (Alerts)**: each event gets a switch + sound dropdown + preview button;
  a volume slider; and **「前台运行时不提醒」** (don't alert while in foreground — alert only when running in the background).
* **「系统通知」 (System notification)**: a single master switch (asks for notification permission when enabled).
  Once on, a system notification is sent when the model **needs your answer / needs your approval / completes the task**; failures stay silent to avoid noise.
  System notifications and sound are **two independent channels** — muting silences sound only, not notifications.
* **「自定义音频」 (Custom audio)**: click **「选择文件」** (choose file) to upload your own audio (mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a, up to 2 MB each).
dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 3. Full settings dialog (click the gear)：The repository address is shown at the bottom of the dialog.

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · 4. Temporary mute：The speaker button at the bottom-left of the composer:

* Click once → 已关闭提示音 (sound off)
* Click again → 已开启提示音 (sound on)

"Sound" here is what gets muted: muting does not disable system notifications.

This switch **resets on restart**, so you cannot leave it off by accident.

dsh-notify-sound-plus README · FAQ：**1. No sound at all?**

Check that sound is enabled in your browser or on the desktop app, that the mode is not `关闭提醒` (alerts off), and that the speaker button is not muted.

**2. Worried about duplicate alerts from other plugins?**

Set the mode to `智能判断` (smart).

**3. Can I use my own sound?**

Yes. In settings, click **「选择文件」** (choose file) and pick a file — mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a, up to 2 MB.

**4. What if I run into a problem?**
dsh-notify-sound-plus README · FAQ：Feedback is very welcome! Please open an Issue at https://github.com/SciF-Lin/dsh-notify-sound-plus and we will fix it as soon as possible.
